author: Mark Atwood
text: Fixed on this branch (uncommitted): tx_queue.c now extends each 32-bit monotonic sample onto a queue-local 64-bit time base (tx_queue_now64/extend_now64) and stores a 64-bit absolute deadline per entry; expiry compares in 64-bit so an entry serviced >=2^31 ms past its deadline stays expired (same provenance pattern as the .4 64-bit enqueue_order fix). Regression: test_stale_deadline_not_resurrected_after_half_range in lichen/tests/tx_queue/main.c (exact half-range, half-range+wrap, and long-but-legal-future cases). Host ASan+UBSan and TSan: 37/37.
